entries.final_answer: Every push to main that touches a docsite input, and a plain workflow_dispatch, runs docs-pages.yml: the pages probe, then the doc-kitty build from the shared docs-site-build.yml with pages-artifact true, then the deploy from main of the core repository only, then the post-deploy smoketest. DocFX is no longer built or published by this workflow. Answered from the operator brief for #6938 PR B.
entries.question: What publishes the docsite after cutover, and when?

entries.final_answer: A job with needs: deploy, main only, read permissions only, runs python3 -m scripts.docs.site_live_probe https://docs.spec-kitty.ai after every deploy and fails the run on a mismatch. No auto-filed alert issue: the operator decided a red run is the signal, so #2361's optional alert issue is not adopted. Answered from the operator brief.
entries.question: How does the post-deploy smoketest report a mismatch?

entries.final_answer: Deploy stays main-only and core-repository-only behind the pages probe-then-configure job, the pages concurrency group, least-privilege permissions and SHA pins; a failed doc-kitty build blocks the deploy; nothing publishes from a fork or off main. Rollback is reverting the PR (ADR D-13 step 4): the DocFX build path, docfx.json, toc.yml, the template and the DocFX scripts stay in the tree until #6943, and a revert restores the DocFX build and deploy jobs, the canary jobs and docs/llms.txt. docs/llms.txt is deleted with every live reference; immutable history is untouched. Answered from the operator brief.
entries.question: What must always hold, and what must a revert restore?

entries.final_answer: One live-probe mechanism: the canary jobs (canary-build, canary-deploy, canary-probe) and the canary dispatch input are removed; the post-deploy smoketest reuses the same probe on every deploy, so a canary of the current site would be a second, redundant path. The DocFX build job is removed from docs-pages.yml as well: it would build a site nothing publishes, and a DocFX failure would turn a successful doc-kitty deploy red. The DocFX sources (docfx.json, toc.yml, the template, scripts and their tests) stay until #6943; a revert of this PR restores the DocFX build and deploy jobs and the canary. Brief-derived engineering decision.
entries.question: What happens to the canary jobs and to the DocFX build in docs-pages.yml?

entries.final_answer: Workflow default contents: read. pages job: pages: read (GET the Pages site and configure-pages without enablement read only). build job (calls the shared build): contents: read. deploy: pages: write and id-token: write, nothing else. smoketest: contents: read. Brief-derived engineering decision.
